description: Procurement of essential medicines and other medical supplies from the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and Local Manufacturers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-07-21 to call for Expressions of Interest/Requests for Proposals to procure medicines and other medical supplies for the year 2026 from the local manufacturers. In response, applications have been received from 48 institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award procurements for the purchase of medicines and other medical supplies from the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and local manufacturers, based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
